text:
48. Protection in this context does not apply in respect of the characteristics of age, marriage or
civil partnership.
Education

49. The coverage extends to schools, further and higher education and general qualifications
bodies. Once again it is wide ranging, including in relation to admissions and exclusions,
terms of provision and other detrimental treatment.

50. In relation to schools, protection does not apply in respect of age, marriage or civil
partnership discrimination.
Associations

51. The provisions regarding scope are complex and are set out in Part 7. Broadly, the EqA

2010 applies to any association of 25 or more members which has rules about how to
become a member, including a genuine selection process.
The Equality Act 2010

For example, this may include organisations such as sports clubs, clubs for people with
particular interests, the Rotary Club, Scouts and Guides, and organisations established to
promote the interests of their members.
